project.name: @kawase/mobile
project.productType: AI-agent money app on Arc (Circle's L1): the agent is the front door; one Expo app for iOS, Android and the web

direction.name: Senryo
direction.summary: Senryo's look exactly (plan D5): light-first neutrals, magenta accent with black labels, condensed display type for money; token values change, names stay.

desktop.name: trade-panel
desktop.author: ssychui
desktop.port: apps/mobile/src/trade/trade-panel.tsx: caption row with what's available, a big tabular amount, presets (1/4 1/2 3/4 All), a CTA whose label is the state
desktop.deviations: Long / Short segmented instead of the token flip; leverage opt-in (Senryo D-344); one hero figure (You put in -> exposure); liquidation, health, rates and fees behind one disclosure; SlideToConfirm instead of a button; tokens only (no brand hex)

desktop.name: trade-chart
desktop.author: ssychui
desktop.port: apps/mobile/src/trade/trade-chart.tsx: candles over a volume strip, price axis on the end edge, OHLC readout under the pointer
desktop.deviations: react-native-svg instead of DOM SVG, so one drawing serves iOS, Android and the web (desktop docs pack section 4); entry, liquidation (with the danger zone washed), take-profit and stop-loss drawn as levels; the live price moves the last bar; wicks merged into one path and bodies into two, capped at 150 bars

desktop.name: positions-panel
desktop.author: ssychui
desktop.port: apps/mobile/src/trade/positions-panel.tsx: table columns on desktop (market, size, entry, mark, liquidation, P&L), two-line rows on the phone, the outcome as a signed figure
desktop.deviations: live P&L in rolling digits; the order being priced shown first with a draining freshness ring; sign and colour together, never colour alone

desktop.name: drain-ring
desktop.author: hihahihahoho
desktop.source: 21st.dev Circle Progress (countdown variant), drawn the way Senryo's CountdownRing draws it
desktop.port: apps/mobile/src/trade/drain-ring.tsx: react-native-svg arc that drains counter-clockwise over a time window
desktop.deviations: the last fifth thickens instead of changing hue, so time never reads as gain or loss; replaced by the Look lane's CountdownRing when the kit lands

desktop.name: rolling-number
desktop.author: unlumen
desktop.port: apps/mobile/src/trade/rolling-number.tsx: only changed digits roll, up on a rise and down on a fall; Reanimated on the UI thread
desktop.deviations: reduced motion shows the new figure at once; screen readers hear the whole figure once; replaced by the Look lane's RollingFigure when the kit lands
